S.description: teleported S: |Y> resource; Z_q Z_y (u); X_y readout (w); frame Z_q^(u xor w)

Sdg.description: S^dagger for recovery: the S gadget followed by frame Z_q  (frame Z_q^(u xor w xor 1))

T1.description: T injection segment T1: |T> resource; Z_q Z_a (u); X_a readout (w); frame Z_q^w.  Branch operator ~ T for u = 0 and ~ T^dagger for u = 1 (S^u is applied by T2)
T1.intended_unitary: T if u = 0 else T^dagger (S^u applied by T2)

T2.description: T injection segment T2: S iff u = 1 (records: '0' = skip; '1uw' = the S gadget with its bits u, w)
T2.source: ls_instructions_from_gates.cpp (SingleQubitOp S, predicated on u) -> teleported_s_gate_injection_stream.cpp
T2.intended_unitary: S^u (u = the decoded T1 ZZ result)
T2.note: records for u = 1 sum to 1 over the S gadget's private bits; u = 0 is one record

T2_S.description: T2 taken branch (u = 1): the teleported S gadget

T.description: T injection = T1 then T2 (records: 'uw' for u = 0; 'uw' + S gadget bits for u = 1)

T_ideal.description: T injection with T2 modelled as an ideal conditional S (4 records; used for the C2 T row)

Tdg_as_compiled.description: T^dagger as the compiler lowers it: make_t_gate_instructions ignores is_dagger, so the SAME instructions are emitted and T is executed.  Deliberately failing certificate (documentation).
Tdg_as_compiled.deviation: compiler executes T for a T^dagger gate (is_dagger ignored); recorded, not fixed (design Sec. 1.2)

CNOT_cf_patched.description: patched ZX_WITH_MBM_CONTROL_FIRST: a in |+>; Z_c Z_a (u); X_a X_t (v); Z_a readout (w); frame Z_c^v X_t^(u xor w)

CZ.description: CZ as emitted: H(t); ZX_WITH_MBM_CONTROL_FIRST CNOT(c -> t) [patched: Z_a readout + frame]; H(t).  Mediator placement = the CNOT's annotation / default rule.  With the unpatched CNOT inside, every branch has rank 2 (H is unitary), i.e. the emitted CZ is not a CZ before the D1 patch.
CZ.source: ls_instruction_stream.cpp (ControlledGate, target gate Z) + ls_instructions_from_gates.cpp + D1 patch

CNOT_cf_unpatched.description: pinned ZX_WITH_MBM_CONTROL_FIRST as emitted: a in |+>; Z_c Z_a (u); X_a X_t (v); X_a readout (w). Deliberately failing certificate (Finding R2): every branch has rank 2.

CNOT_tf_Zreadout.description: ZX_WITH_MBM_TARGET_FIRST with the compiler's |+> ancilla and a Z readout: X_a X_t (v); Z_c Z_a (u); Z_a readout (w).  NO Pauli frame makes it a CNOT: X_a X_t on a fresh |+> ancilla measures X_t.
CNOT_tf_Zreadout.deviation: target-first with the compiler's |+> ancilla: the first merge X_a X_t projects the target onto an X eigenstate; no frame repairs a rank loss

CNOT_tf_dual.description: target-first dual (NOT what the compiler emits): a in |0>; X_a X_t (v); Z_c Z_a (u); X_a readout (w); derived frame Z0^(u+w).X1^(v)

SX.description: teleported S on the X boundary: |Y> resource to the right; X_q X_y (u); Z_y readout (w); frame X_q^(1 xor u xor w)
SX.source: SX gadget (r18; cheap-repair.md 6.1, 6.3): teleported_s_gate_injection_stream.cpp's S gadget on the X boundary

SXdg.description: SX^dagger for recovery: the SX gadget followed by frame X_q  (frame X_q^(u xor w))
SXdg.source: SX gadget (r18; cheap-repair.md 6.1, 6.3): teleported_s_gate_injection_stream.cpp's S gadget on the X boundary + frame

RESET.description: QASM `reset q[i]` -> PatchReset{i} (ls_instruction_stream.cpp).  Contract semantics: a reset of a program wire is a destructive operation on that wire -- the state is discarded and a fresh |0> patch appears; the design (Sec. 1.3) treats it as `discard {traced}` of the old lifetime followed by `init {Zero}` of a new one, so a reset of a wire in L is a fence (Sec. 2.2 discard rule).  Not a gadget a residual passes through: no Kraus certificate.
RESET.compiler_semantics: pinned slicer: dense_patch_computation.cpp try_apply_instruction_direct_followup returns {nullptr, {}} for PatchReset -- no patch change, no measurement, no follow-up instruction; wave_scheduler.cpp is_immediate -> true (zero duration); ls_instructions.cpp lists the target as an operating patch and prints the .lss line `Reset <id>`.  The pinned compiler therefore executes NO reset (the patch keeps its state); the discard + init semantics is executed only if the fork implements it.

MEASURE.intended_instrument: projective Z measurement {m: |m><m|}; the wire is discarded after it
MEASURE.description: QASM `measure q[i] -> m[0]` (w10 fork) -> MeasureSinglePatch{i, Z}: a destructive readout of a program patch whose bit m is a program result (the classically controlled CZ of the uncomputation reads it).  The contract walk treats it as an elementary destructive measurement (signed-commutation test and instrument reduction).
